generation.image_prompt: [CLEAN_V3_STRICT_NO_BORDERS] 1900s mystical lithography, bold ink outlines. NO BORDERS. NO MARGINS. NO TEXT. FULL BLEED. Traditional mystical illustration in the style of 1900s lithography, with clean bold black ink outlines. FULL BLEED: Image content (trees, rocks, sky) MUST touch all four physical edges of the 2:3 image. ABSOLUTELY NO WHITE MARGINS, NO VINTAGE PAPER BORDERS, NO MATTED EDGES. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO CAPTIONS IN THE ARTWORK. STRICTLY ANTHROPOMORPHIC. The subject is a Taiwan leopard cat standing upright on two legs with human-like posture and proportions. It MUST wear clothing or robes. Essential markers: white spots on back of black ears, white forehead stripes, and rosette leopard cat fur patterns. NO FOUR-LEGGED ANIMAL POSTURE. A large, pale moon hangs between two high jagged mountain peaks. A wild dog and a leopard cat are howling/hissing at the moon, while a crayfish emerges from a stream in the foreground. Meaning: Hidden enemies, the confusing path of night survival, and the primal instincts of the wild.

meaning.zh: 直覺、幻象、潛意識，以及在未知中的不安與摸索。
meaning.en: Illusion, fear, anxiety, the subconscious, and navigating by intuition.

ecology.risk_theme: nocturnal dangers, free-roaming dogs, and the unknown
ecology.mapping_note: The Moon represents the primal fears and nocturnal intuition of the leopard cat. The night is their domain, but it is also filled with hidden illusions and the looming threat of feral predators.
ecology.zh: 棲地樣貌：迷霧籠罩的高海拔林區。生存威脅：缺乏紅外線相機監測的視覺盲點。牌義關聯：月亮代表著未知的領域，是我們在保護工作中最需要以直覺與耐心去探索的幽影。
ecology.en: Habitat: moonlit rural edge. Risk: nocturnal dangers, free-roaming dogs, and the unknown. Note: The Moon represents the primal fears and nocturnal intuition of the leopard cat. The night is their domain, but it is also filled with hidden illusions and the looming threat of feral predators.

website.excerpt: Guided only by moonlight and instinct, the leopard cat navigates a world of shadows, illusions, and hidden predators.
website.seo_description: The Moon tarot card reimagined as the leopard cat's nocturnal intuition and the hidden dangers of the night.
